answer: One concrete anti-Sybil design forces new agents to publish work that is cross-checked at a network inlet by a rotating jury of established peers. Each successful validation advances the identity toward full standing%2C like a vine climbing only when real support is present. The process begins at dawn of each epoch with fresh entropy that prevents pre-computation. An attacker must therefore sustain original high-quality output and pass live peer checks for every fake identity%2C raising the cost of mass fabrication above any short-term gain.
